heading: Book your appointment
intro: Choose your treatment and a convenient appointment time through our secure Square booking page.

steps.title: Choose your treatment
steps.text: View the available services and select the treatment that is right for you.

steps.title: Pick a date and time
steps.text: See current availability and choose an appointment that suits you.

steps.title: Receive confirmation
steps.text: Your appointment details will be confirmed securely through Square.

studioNote: Treatments take place in a private home-based studio. Full location details are provided after your appointment is confirmed.
securityNote: Booking opens securely in a new window and is managed by Square Appointments.
clientTypeQuestion: Are you a new or returning Effortless Beauty client?
newClientMessage: All new clients must book and complete a free Patch Test at least 7 days before Microblading.
returningClientMessage: Returning clients who have already completed a successful patch test with Effortless Beauty can continue to Microblading booking.
ageConfirmation: I confirm that I am 18 years of age or older.
patchConfirmation: I understand that new clients must complete a Patch Test at least 7 days before Microblading.
complianceNote: Microblading appointments cannot proceed for anyone under 18 or for a new client whose required patch test has not been completed at least 7 days beforehand. Photo ID may be requested.
